transcript: Here's the fastest way to lower your stress. It's been used for decades in the East, but is barely known in the West. Stop trying to control and change other people. Let them be who they are. Let them think what they think. Say what they say. Do what they do. Feel what they feel. And instead of focusing on them, focus on you. On what you think, what you feel, what you do. The moment you stop trying to control everyone else, you start feeling more in control of yourself. Because let's be honest, the number one source of stress in our lives is other people. They're rude. They have opinions we don't like. They bring expectations, guilt, pressure. And here's the shift. Instead of letting other people drain your energy, let them. Let them be who they are, especially your family. They've been the same since the day you were born. So why exhaust yourself wishing they would change? You can't change another person. People only change when they decide to. When you stop fighting reality, your nervous system finally gets to rest. If you're tired of carrying stress that isn't yours, the way back to stillness will help you release it. It's in the link on my profile. This is where the practice continues.
